prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1011; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change on a multi-lane roadway. Insured states the other vehicle merged into their lane without signaling. Both drivers reported as having sustained minor vehicle damage at the rear quarter and passenger side. Claimant reports concussion symptoms and has been transported for evaluation. Liability under review pending statements and scene photographs.

Entry 2: Obtained recorded statements from both drivers and one independent witness. Witness corroborates that the claimant's vehicle moved laterally into the adjacent lane. Dashcam footage from the insured vehicle requested. Preliminary liability assessment leans toward the claimant's vehicle as the primary contributor, subject to footage review.

Entry 3: Claimant is now represented by counsel. All further communication to be directed to the attorney of record. Letter of representation received and placed in file. Medical authorization and records request sent to counsel. Bodily injury reserve set at the initial evaluation level pending receipt of treatment records.

Entry 4: Dashcam footage received and reviewed. Footage shows the claimant's vehicle drifting toward the lane line for several seconds before contact, consistent with the insured's account. Supervisor notified of the liability position. Reviewing applicable comparative fault rules for the jurisdiction before issuing any position to counsel.

Entry 5: Counsel's office acknowledged receipt of the liability position and requested additional time to review the footage. Medical records still outstanding; follow-up sent. Concussion diagnosis documented by treating provider, with a referral for neurological follow-up. Claim remains open. Next review scheduled once records and counsel's response are received.
